name: PassForge
shortDescription: Secure password and passphrase generator built on Python's secrets module, with honest strength guidance.
features: Configurable length and character groups with policy validation
Guaranteed character-group coverage; secrets-only randomness (Fisher-Yates via randbelow)
Passphrases from a bundled, documented word list
Optional export with 0600 permissions; passwords are never logged
Explain command that states what generation does and does not guarantee
knownLimitations: Does not store, score or transmit passwords (generation is not storage)
Strength guidance is honest, not a strength guarantee
